evm_balance_details_contract_check.name: evm_balance_details_contract_check
evm_balance_details_contract_check.value: ("evm_balance_observation_details"."asset_kind" = 'native' and "evm_balance_observation_details"."contract_address_lower" is null and "evm_balance_observation_details"."token_decimals" = 18) or ("evm_balance_observation_details"."asset_kind" = 'erc20' and "evm_balance_observation_details"."contract_address_lower" is not null)

evm_l2_gas_fee_exact_fields_check.name: evm_l2_gas_fee_exact_fields_check
evm_l2_gas_fee_exact_fields_check.value: ("evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."fee_status" = 'exact' and "evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."execution_fee_atomic_text" is not null and "evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."parent_data_fee_atomic_text" is not null and "evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."total_fee_atomic_text" is not null) or ("evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."fee_status" = 'unresolved' and "evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."total_fee_atomic_text" is null)

evm_l2_gas_fee_operator_check.name: evm_l2_gas_fee_operator_check
evm_l2_gas_fee_operator_check.value: ("evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."chain_id" = 8453 and (("evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."fee_status" = 'exact' and "evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."operator_fee_atomic_text" is not null) or "evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."fee_status" = 'unresolved')) or ("evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."chain_id" = 42161 and "evm_l2_gas_fee_details"."operator_fee_atomic_text" is null)

file_import_profiles_fingerprint_check.name: file_import_profiles_fingerprint_check
file_import_profiles_fingerprint_check.value: "file_import_profiles"."statement_account_fingerprint" is null or (length("file_import_profiles"."statement_account_fingerprint") = 64 and "file_import_profiles"."statement_account_fingerprint" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

latest_quote_observation_check.name: latest_quote_observation_check
latest_quote_observation_check.value: "latest_price_quotes"."provider_observed_at" is not null or "latest_price_quotes"."provider_observation_date" is not null

recurring_items_amount_shape_check.name: recurring_items_amount_shape_check
recurring_items_amount_shape_check.value: ("recurring_items"."amount_mode" = 'exact' and "recurring_items"."amount_atomic_text" is not null and "recurring_items"."tolerance_bps" is null and "recurring_items"."min_amount_atomic_text" is null and "recurring_items"."max_amount_atomic_text" is null) or ("recurring_items"."amount_mode" = 'approx' and "recurring_items"."amount_atomic_text" is not null and "recurring_items"."tolerance_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "recurring_items"."min_amount_atomic_text" is null and "recurring_items"."max_amount_atomic_text" is null) or ("recurring_items"."amount_mode" = 'range' and "recurring_items"."amount_atomic_text" is null and "recurring_items"."tolerance_bps" is null and "recurring_items"."min_amount_atomic_text" is not null and "recurring_items"."max_amount_atomic_text" is not null)

recurring_items_amount_atomic_check.name: recurring_items_amount_atomic_check
recurring_items_amount_atomic_check.value: ("recurring_items"."amount_atomic_text" is null or ("recurring_items"."amount_atomic_text" not glob '*[^0-9]*' and length("recurring_items"."amount_atomic_text") > 0 and "recurring_items"."amount_atomic_text" <> '0')) and ("recurring_items"."min_amount_atomic_text" is null or ("recurring_items"."min_amount_atomic_text" not glob '*[^0-9]*' and length("recurring_items"."min_amount_atomic_text") > 0 and "recurring_items"."min_amount_atomic_text" <> '0')) and ("recurring_items"."max_amount_atomic_text" is null or ("recurring_items"."max_amount_atomic_text" not glob '*[^0-9]*' and length("recurring_items"."max_amount_atomic_text") > 0 and "recurring_items"."max_amount_atomic_text" <> '0'))

recurring_items_monthly_mode_check.name: recurring_items_monthly_mode_check
recurring_items_monthly_mode_check.value: ("recurring_items"."frequency" = 'monthly' and "recurring_items"."monthly_day_mode" in ('fixed', 'last')) or ("recurring_items"."frequency" <> 'monthly' and "recurring_items"."monthly_day_mode" is null)
